braids.line: The maiden wore her beads and braids
stanza: He always wore his Sunday feathers
And held a tomahawk
The maiden wore her beads and braids

Kaw-Liga, too stubborn to ever show a sign
Because his heart was made of knotty pine

fades.line: The days pass so slowly and it never fades
stanza: I'll admit I'm lonely
And need someone to hold me
Just to sleep at night
But I'd rather be alone
Rather wake up on my own
Come the morning time
The days pass so slowly and it never fades
Evening comes, I'm looking for somebody else
These are things I say only when I'm talking to myself

I come out wearing my brother's red hat

spades.line: Well, I'll return to the Queen of Spades
stanza: Well, I'll return to the Queen of Spades

She knows that I’m not afraid to look at her
She is good to me
